definitions.gloss: muttering; grumbling; complaining under one's breath
definitions.explanation: Speaking in a low voice, often in complaint.
Describes a surface with many small bumps.

examples.japanese: ぶつぶつ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何：00498_nani⟧ぶつぶつ⟦{言|い}っていた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
ぶつぶつ⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{早|はや}くやりなさい→早い：00514_hayai⟧。
examples.english: Stop grumbling and do it quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{刺|さ}されて→刺す：02111_sasu⟧ぶつぶつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I got bumps from insect bites.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶつぶつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧できて⟦{痒|かゆ}い→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧。
examples.english: I have bumps on my arm and they're itchy.

notes:
ぶつぶつ is an onomatopoeic word with two distinct meanings: (1) the sound of grumbling/muttering, and (2) a texture of small bumps, especially on skin.

COMMON PATTERNS (muttering):
- ぶつぶつ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to mutter, to grumble
- ぶつぶつ⟦{文句|もんく}→文句：03636_monku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to mutter complaints

COMMON PATTERNS (bumps):
- ぶつぶつができる: bumps appear (on skin)
- ぶつぶつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: bumps break out

NOUN USAGE:
When referring to skin bumps, ぶつぶつ functions as a noun: ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶつぶつ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧ (bumps appeared on my skin). Casual alternative to ⟦{発疹|はっしん}→発疹：20451_hasshin⟧ (rash).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ぼそぼそ→ぼそぼそ：09453_bosoboso⟧: mumbling quietly (less complaining)
- ぶつぶつ: implies dissatisfaction or complaint
- ⟦つぶつぶ→つぶつぶ：noentry⟧: grainy texture (small grains, not bumps)
